title: Dance Break
description: Catholic pilgrims perform flamenco during a stop at Doñana National Park along their spring journey to the Virgin of El Rocío shrine in Andalusia, Spain. Each year, more than a million pilgrims travel to the site either on foot or horseback to honor the Virgin Mary. The journey takes place 50 days after Easter on Pentecost weekend.
translated_description: 在西班牙安达卢西亚地区，天主教朝圣者春季前往埃尔罗西奥圣母圣殿途中，于多尼亚纳国家公园停留时表演弗拉门戈舞。每年有超过百万朝圣者徒步或骑马前往该地敬奉圣母玛利亚。这段朝圣之旅于复活节后50天的圣灵降临节周末进行。
